channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Countryfile
channel.desc: Matt Baker and Emily McGowen are in the Cotswolds for the biggest date in the sheepdog trialling calendar - the Supreme. The finest dogs and handlers from across the UK and Ireland go head-to-head in a thrilling showcase of instinct, skill and control. After months of training and a year of tough qualifying trials, it all comes down to this - but only one will claim the coveted title of Supreme Champion.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: The show comes from Normanby Hall in Lincolnshire. The experts find the most interesting items to take off to auction, while Paul Martin learns how the stately home was turned into a hospital for the forces during World War I.
